scientific_integrity: All asymptotic limits follow from analytic localization and a Bellman recurrence. Numerical evidence only checks finite cases. No universal rate over arbitrary credal sets is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Disk uncertainty family with fixed \(0<r<(1+\sqrt{2})^{-1}\); not a claim for other convex bodies.
Possible earlier equivalent formulations outside the inspected literature remain a residual originality risk.
title: A universal logarithmic horizon penalty under disk-valued reachability uncertainty
